senses.en: completely get rid of sth. that is unnecessary or unwanted
examples: There is no solution that will totally [[eliminate]] the possibility of theft.

senses.en: the practice of limiting your interests or activities to one particular subject
examples: Increased [[specialization]] has reduced the number of doctors who are good at managing emergencies.
His [[specialization]] in translation led him to start his own company.

senses.en: an activity or subject that you know a lot about
examples: Increased [[specialization]] has reduced the number of doctors who are good at managing emergencies.
His [[specialization]] in translation led him to start his own company.

senses.en: (BrE also routinise) if you routinize a way of doing sth., you make it a normal part of a job or process
examples: To improve efficiency, [[routinize]] as much of your morning as possible.

senses.en: start using computers and machines to do a job, rather than people
examples: Massive investment is needed to [[automate]] the production process.

senses.zh: （电台）音乐唱片节目主持人；（俱乐部）打碟师，舞曲唱片播放员
senses.en: (disc jockey) sb. who plays records on a radio show or in a club where you can dance
as a result
examples: The company is trying to reduce its costs; [[consequently]], staff who leave are not being replaced.

senses.en: judge how good, useful, or successful sth. is
examples: It can be difficult to [[evaluate]] the effectiveness of different medical treatments.

senses.en: (technical)

senses.zh: 操纵，控制（某人的思想和行为）
senses.en: make sb. think and behave exactly as you want them to, by skillfully deceiving or influencing them
examples: As a politician, he knows how to [[manipulate]] public opinion.

senses.zh: 神秘的；不可思议的；难以解释的
senses.en: (also mystic) (usu. before noun) having spiritual powers or qualities that are difficult to understand or to explain
examples: Watching the sun rise over the mountain was an almost [[mystical]] experience.

senses.en: connected with the chemistry of living things
examples: People can become addicted to the [[biochemical]] changes brought about by vigorous exercise.

senses.en: (usu. before noun) using measurements of human features, such as fingers or eyes, in order to identify people
examples: The major [[biometric]] methods include face, voice, and fingerprint recognition.

senses.en: guess sth. using as many facts as you can find
examples: Researchers [[calculated]] that this group was at a higher risk of heart disease.
You should [[calculate]] how much time this assignment will take before you start doing it.

senses.en: find out how much sth. will cost, how long sth. will take, etc., by using numbers
examples: Researchers [[calculated]] that this group was at a higher risk of heart disease.
You should [[calculate]] how much time this assignment will take before you start doing it.

senses.en: a careful examination of sth. in order to understand it better
examples: At the meeting, they presented a detailed [[analysis]] of 12 schools in London.

senses.en: the information produced by a computer
examples: You run the software, you look at the [[output]], and then you make modifications (修改).
Government statistics show the largest drop in industrial [[output]] for 10 years.

senses.en: the amount of goods or work produced by a person, machine, factory, etc.
examples: You run the software, you look at the [[output]], and then you make modifications (修改).
Government statistics show the largest drop in industrial [[output]] for 10 years.

senses.zh: 根据特定需要制作；定做
senses.en: make sth. so that it is exactly right for sb.'s particular needs or for a particular purpose
examples: Most travel agents are willing to [[tailor]] travel arrangements to meet individual requirements.

senses.en: a feeling of extreme unhappiness
examples: Luke's poor academic performance caused his parents great [[distress]].

senses.en: a tune, esp. the main tune in a piece of music written for several instruments or voices
examples: They played some lovely [[melodies]] at the end of the concert.

senses.zh: （某地方、某人或某情况等的）特点，独特性
senses.en: sth. that is a feature of only one particular place, person, situation, etc.
examples: A sharp ringing in the ears is a [[peculiarity]] of the disease.

senses.en: write a piece of music
examples: Mozart [[composed]] his last opera shortly before he passed away.
The committee is [[composed]] of doctors, nurses and members of the public.

senses.en: (be composed of) be formed from a number of substances, parts, or people
examples: Mozart [[composed]] his last opera shortly before he passed away.
The committee is [[composed]] of doctors, nurses and members of the public.

senses.en: (BrE also personalised) adapted to personal requirements or tastes
examples: His car has a [[personalized]] number plate.

senses.en: apart from sb. / sth.; in addition to sb. / sth.
examples: I've got no family [[besides]] my parents.

senses.en: be even better or greater than sb. / sth. else
examples: The film's success has [[surpassed]] all expectations.

senses.en: be more successful than sb. / sth. else
examples: In recent years, our economy has [[outperformed]] most other industrial economies.

senses.en: the type of work sb. does
examples: You can expect to meet some very interesting people in my [[line of work]].

senses.en: later in the future, not immediately
examples: It seems a lot of effort but I'm sure it's the best solution [[in the long run]].

senses.en: used to emphasize that sb. has human feelings or weaknesses, often when contrasting them with machines
examples: I am only [[flesh and blood]], like anyone else.

senses.en: search or examine sth. very carefully
examples: [[Go over]] your work before you hand it in.

senses.zh: 认识到某事物，了解某事物（如自己的情感、态度等）
senses.en: (esp. AmE) realize and understand sth. such as your feelings and attitudes
examples: I am finally able to [[get in touch with]] who I am.

senses.en: become less sad, or make sb. feel less sad
examples: Here is a bit of news that will [[cheer up]] you.

english: sb.'s heart skips / misses a beat

senses.zh: 某人心跳停顿了一下（表示突然感到惊恐、兴奋等）
senses.en: used to say sb. suddenly feels a moment of fear, excitement, etc.
examples: My heart [[skipped a beat]] when I saw who it was.

senses.zh: （在编辑、剪辑等过程中）删除，去掉
senses.en: remove sth. when you are preparing a book, a piece of film, etc. for printing or broadcasting
examples: Anything offensive will be [[edited out]] at a later stage of the production.

senses.zh: 利用（某一感情、事实或观点）
senses.en: use a feeling, fact, or idea in order to get what you want, often in an unfair way
examples: The advertisement [[plays on]] our emotions, showing a doctor holding a newborn baby.

senses.en: become popular and fashionable
examples: The idea of glasses being a fashion item has been slow to [[catch on]].

english: stand / have a chance / hope (of doing sth.)

senses.zh: 有机会 / 有希望（做某事）
senses.en: be likely to be able to do sth. or to succeed
examples: She will [[stand a chance]] of passing the exam if she works hard.
